featured_reviews.name: Samiran Dey
featured_reviews.review_text: I looked all around Kolkata for the sunroof module for a pre worshipped Mercedes W203 C class that I purchased and could find absolutely NOTHING! Next thing you know, I was searching all over the internet and came across Tawakkal Auto Spares. Checked their website and found the exact part that I was looking for. Contacted them on whatsapp to check on pricing and availability and got a prompt response. Requested them to give me a little time to source the cash and placed the order with them on a Friday about a week and a half later. Received the product on the subsequent Monday and took it right away to my mechanic. Worked like a charm, as described and the packaging was excellent. Completely recommend buying difficult to source electrical and mechanical spare parts for your premium European Cars anywhere in India. They offer really good pricing and shipping rates too.
